editionLabel: Fantasy Flight Games English rulebook, 2022 publisher posting
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has most recently been betrayed takes the first player token and starts.
clarifications: Starting with that player and continuing clockwise, players choose leader cards during setup.

sources.title: A Game of Thrones: B'Twixt — Fantasy Flight Games rules

internalEvidence: The Fantasy Flight B'Twixt product page links this English rulebook with a 2022 posting. Rendered PDF page 2 states that the player most recently betrayed takes the first player token. PDF page 3 continues with clockwise leader choice from that player. The source belongs to the three-to-six-player B'Twixt card game, not the distinct Game of Thrones board game. Local source SHA-256: 83e15662fdf174c62fdcaa4910bfdce4e5f8b8d4efb3833cb6d5732cd9fad6ba. Product page: https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/a-game-of-thrones-btwixt/. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not state how to resolve equally recent betrayals.
